description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kiribamunegama, Polpithigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - (25/0012)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring title determinations for multiple land parcels in various villages. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and classifications, falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
